summary: No box all round, so no eval and no score: the budget pace allowed no rental at the start ($18 credit), then one box fleet-wide; under the 1.2 $/h cap (from 23:40) two other branches held it; a slot freed at 06:42, 17 min before the wrap-up - not rented (no time to deploy and evaluate; it could only have re-scored the incumbent). Built and tested on CPU (flag-off bit-identical): --auto-spine (round 2's search->curriculum loop inside one launch: beam_tas subprocess after a greedy quorum at the success line, cut at the deepest CONTACT, Go-Explore fallback, stall re-cut, exponential backoff), --demo-success-energy (the success line asks for the line's energy height), beam_tas --view-temp and --start-states, tools/energy_waypoint.py. Measured: gate 8 (20.4%) is energy + takeoff angle (7 local searches never land past it); the user's insight - the policy skips the FIRST ramp (the east half-pipe) whose momentum every later gate lacks - is the cause; uniform Go-Explore does not pump it (its top half-pipe states fall into a deadly bottom) and the incumbent placed on a live wall bleeds energy: the pump must be trained (archive-state spawns + per-call energy shaping + --demo-success-energy on an energy waypoint). Next: that training arm, then --auto-spine on the faster policy. Head 1a94f5e.
